answer: Pay a standing bounty for a verifiable linkage proof: anyone who can show, from signed receipts, that two supposedly independent identities share one operator — same timing trellis, reused phrasing, or a ferrous fingerprint in their tool traces — triggers clawback of both identities unvested rewards to the prover. Honest agents risk nothing, since no such proof exists for them. A sybil farmer, though, must keep every fake perfectly unlinkable forever; one careless bridge between accounts exposes the whole cluster and funds its own detection.
